dataset.name: Kiltunnel toll
dataset.method: The Kiltunnel's toll (Dordrecht–Hoeksche Waard) per passage, either way, for vehicles over 2.30 m high including load (trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be): EUR 5 cash, with `etc` the Telecard price, EUR 3.8. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

vehicles.description: Vehicles over 2.30 m high (here trucks over 3.5 t)

network.description: The Kiltunnel (N217), charged at its toll plaza either way.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
